name: meisijiya-redesign-ui
description: Audit-then-fix workflow for existing web/mobile UI in any framework. Scans the codebase, runs a layered design audit (typography / color / layout / interactivity / content / components / icons / code / a11y / strategic omissions), fixes the highest-leverage items in priority order without breaking functionality or migrating frameworks.

positive_triggers.input: Our site looks templated. Audit it and fix the cheap defaults without breaking routes
Replace Inter with Geist everywhere; bring the design closer to Linear without a full rewrite
positive_triggers.reason: Specific high-leverage fix on existing code

positive_triggers.input: We just shipped a v1 landing — sweep it for AI tells and bad states before launch

negative_triggers.input: Design and build a brand-new marketing site from scratch
Fix this React state-management bug causing infinite re-renders
Redesign the backend API surface area
negative_triggers.reason: Out of scope; this skill is UI-only

behavioral_evals.scenario: User asks: 'Our site looks templated. Audit it and fix the cheap defaults without breaking routes'
expected_behavior: Agent performs the §1 scan inventory (framework, styling, components, animation, icons, state, tests)
Agent runs the §2 audit across all 9 layers, listing findings with file:line
Agent applies fixes in §3 priority order (fonts → color → states → layout → components → states → polish)
Agent never migrates frameworks or styling libraries
Agent runs the §2 audit a second time on the post-fix state; pass 1 findings must be gone
Agent runs the §Verification checklist before declaring done

behavioral_evals.scenario: User requests a specific high-leverage fix on existing code
expected_behavior: Agent identifies which audit layer the fix belongs to
Agent verifies the change does not break existing routes / tests / dependencies
Agent scopes the change to the smallest diff possible
Agent documents the fix with a one-line note (commit or PR body)
Agent runs visual regression sweep on adjacent pages affected by token changes

notes: v0.1.0 — based on Leonxlnx/taste-skill redesign-skill (MIT). Behavioral evals are warning-level until promoted via upstream issue tracker.
